name: dim_d2c_order
comment: Lightweight order-header lookup for D2C orders (one row per order, not per line item) — use this to count distinct orders or find which customer/date an order_name belongs to without double-counting across line items.

columns.name: order_name
columns.comment: Shopify order number/name; unique per order.

columns.name: order_date_key
columns.comment: Calendar date the order was placed.

columns.name: customer_email
columns.comment: Email address the customer used to place this order.
